boundary_cautions: A cracked SCREEN PROTECTOR shows a fracture line floating above the display surface, often ending abruptly at a rectangular protector edge inset from the device edge. If protector-crack is plausible, report confidence <= 0.5 and note it.
Reflections and glare in mirror captures can mimic crack lines. A crack persists across views E1 and E2; a reflection moves. Do not report severity above cosmetic from a single view.
Hairline crack vs scratch: a crack shows as a continuous bright/dark line that crosses reflections; when unsure choose scratch with a note.

bend.definition: Overall curvature of the device body visible along an edge sight-line. Structural damage.

burn_in.definition: Ghost image of persistent UI elements visible on uniform background, screen ON.

corrosion_visible.definition: Green/white residue or rust-colour deposits visible inside a port. Weak proxy for liquid exposure.

crack.definition: One or more distinct fracture lines in glass; glass surface still largely intact.

dead_pixels.definition: Individual pixels or clusters permanently dark or stuck on a colour, visible only with screen ON.

deep_scratch.definition: Gouge exposing under-layer material of the frame.

dent.definition: Localized inward deformation of frame or body.

discoloration.definition: Regions of wrong colour, tint, or bleeding, visible only with screen ON.

other.definition: Any observed damage that does not fit the definitions above. Findings of this type ALWAYS route the case to human review.

scratch.definition: Surface abrasion without fracture; does not catch light as a continuous line the way a crack does.

shatter.definition: Web-like or spidering fracture pattern; glass fragmented or missing in places.

touch_fault.definition: Touch input not registering in some region. Only assessable via the challenge interaction, never from a static photo. Static photos must not produce this finding.

severity_anchors.cosmetic: Visible only on close inspection; does not affect use; comparable to refurbisher grade-A/B wear (light hairline marks, minor scuffs).
severity_anchors.moderate: Clearly visible at arm's length; device fully functional; comparable to refurbisher grade-C wear (distinct crack line, noticeable dent).
severity_anchors.none: No visible damage of this type.
severity_anchors.severe: Immediately obvious; spreads across a large area or affects structure/function (branching or shattered glass, bent frame, dead display region).
